headline: Six packs get XSIAM 3.19 identity.* modeling rules; MS Graph Security stops mapping every host to the tenant ID
summary_md:
- A campaign (CRTX-271523, PRs 1 and 3 of 7) adds a second modeling rule to six packs that mirrors every `xdm.*.user.*` mapping into `xdm.*.identity.*`, gated to platform 8.15.0 while the old rule is capped at 8.14.0.
- **Microsoft Graph Security** fixed `xdm.source.host.device_id`, which was mapped to `tenantId` and therefore identical on every alert.
- **Druva** gained modeling for Cybersecurity events; **PAN-OS** added polling to `pan-os-platform-get-system-status`.
- **Core** removed the `SearchIndicatorInEventsAgentix` script, superseded by the managed Agentix pack.
- **SOCRadar** and **GenericAPICall** were Docker image bumps only.

highlights.title: Every Microsoft Graph Security alert reported the same device_id
highlights.detail: `xdm.source.host.device_id` was mapped to `tenantId` — the Entra tenant, identical across all alerts — and is now `coalesce(deviceEvidence.mdeDeviceId, deviceEvidence.azureAdDeviceId)`, with `xdm.source.host.hostname` newly mapped from `deviceEvidence.hostName`.

highlights.title: identity.* modeling rules ship as parallel 3.19 rule versions, not in-place edits
highlights.detail: Each pack keeps its existing rule with a new `toversion: 8.14.0` and adds a `<Pack>_3_19` rule at `fromversion: 8.15.0`, so the identity fields only populate on Cortex XSIAM 3.19 and later.

highlights.title: Druva's schema swapped timeStamp for timestamp and gained a Cybersecurity event set
highlights.detail: The modeling rule schema drops `timeStamp` and adds `timestamp` alongside `category`, `details`, `type`, `feature`, `syslogSeverity`, `facility`, `profileID` and `globalID` for the Cybersecurity stream.

highlights.title: Three Agentix actions and a script were removed as capped at 8.13.0
highlights.detail: `SearchIndicatorInEventsAgentix` was deleted from Core, and the Base and Core release notes record `SendMail`, `CortexRunXQLQuery` and `CortexCreateAppSecPolicy` as removed in favour of the managed Agentix pack — though those notes are commented out and surface only as "Documentation and metadata improvements".

highlights.title: PAN-OS can now wait for a device to come back up
highlights.detail: `pan-os-platform-get-system-status` accepts `polling=true` and polls the target device until its operational mode reads "normal" or the timeout expires.

items.Packs/MicrosoftGraphSecurity: 2.5.7: device_id remapped from tenantId to deviceEvidence.mdeDeviceId (falling back to azureAdDeviceId), and hostname mapped from deviceEvidence.hostName.
items.Packs/AzureDevOps: 1.4.23: new AzureDevOps_3_19 modeling rule adding xdm.*.identity.* alongside xdm.*.user.*; the existing rule is capped at platform 8.14.0.
items.Packs/Barracuda_Cloudgen_Firewall: 1.0.9: new Barracuda_CGFWModelingRules_3_19 rule adding the xdm.*.identity.* mappings, existing rule capped at 8.14.0.
items.Packs/CybelAngel: 1.1.11: new CybelAngel_3_19 modeling rule adding the xdm.*.identity.* mappings, existing rule capped at 8.14.0.
items.Packs/FortinetFortiwebVM: 2.0.20: new FortinetFortiwebVM_3_19 modeling rule adding the xdm.*.identity.* mappings, existing rule capped at 8.14.0.
items.Packs/NetmotionVPN: 1.0.6: new NetmotionVPN_3_19 modeling rule adding the xdm.*.identity.* mappings, existing rule capped at 8.14.0.
items.Packs/BeyondTrustRemoteSupport: 1.0.6: new BeyondTrustRemoteSupport_3_19 modeling rule adding the xdm.*.identity.* mappings, existing rule capped at 8.14.0.
items.Packs/Druva: 1.3.7: modeling rule and schema extended to cover Druva Cybersecurity events; timeStamp replaced by timestamp.
items.Packs/Core: 3.5.83: deleted the SearchIndicatorInEventsAgentix script, capped at platform 8.13.0 and superseded by the managed Agentix pack.
items.Packs/PAN-OS: 2.6.47: pan-os-platform-get-system-status gained polling=true, waiting for the device to reach operational mode "normal" or time out.
items.Packs/Slack: 3.8.13: fixed an invalid_blocks error from empty markdown delimiters that could stop Cortex Agentic Assistant approval prompts reaching Slack.
items.Packs/ApiModules: 2.4.39: the same empty-markdown-delimiter fix in SlackUtilsApiModule, which SlackV3 shares.
items.Packs/SOCRadar: 2.3.2: Docker bump to demisto/python3:3.12.13.10116658 across all seven SOCRadar integrations. No behaviour change.
items.Packs/Base: 1.42.17: metadata bump recording the removal of the SendMail Agentix Action, capped at platform 8.13.0.
